title: Recipe Clusters
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n m. Then m lines: u v (a directed dependency
u depends on v). Print the size of the largest set of items that are
mutually reachable (directly or transitively).

**Constraints:** 1 <= n <= 50000; 0 <= m <= 120000.

**R versus W.** The graded wrong solution labels components by forward
reach from each unvisited node — a cycle plus everything it can reach
becomes one fake cluster. Target: full solve within 40 minutes.

tests.name: cycle plus a tail
tests.hint: SCCs are {1,2} and {3}: the tail is reachable but not returning. Forward-reach W reports 3.

tests.name: two chained cycles
tests.hint: Cycles {1,2} and {3,4} are separate SCCs; forward reach from 1 swallows all 4.

tests.name: one big cycle
tests.hint: Everything mutually reachable: both approaches say 3.

tests.name: load: 50000 nodes, 120000 edges
tests.hint: Iterative Kosaraju is O(n + m); recursive DFS also risks stack depth at n = 5e4.
